D: Two slackers invent a backyard game that becomes a pro league, then fight to keep it pure.
P: Serve the snacks when the Milwaukee Beers take the court.
S: Fried battered cheese curds, crunchy outside and soft inside, with ranch for dipping. Cut 400g haloumi into 2cm cubes.
the psych-out at the free throw

Soft pretzel bites with beer cheese sauce, the stadium snack for a Beers game. Cut 500g pizza dough into bites, dip in water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 15 seconds, salt and bake at 220C for 10 minutes.
M: Bratwurst simmered in beer and onions, then grilled and served in rolls with mustard and sauerkraut.
W: the game started in the driveway
Vanilla ice cream with chocolate sauce, nuts and a cherry, the post-game treat. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls.
K: Ice-cold lager in plastic cups for the stands, and lemonade for the kids.

s.how: Cut 400g haloumi into 2cm cubes. Dip in a batter of 150g flour, 1 egg and 200ml cold beer and fry at 185C for 1 minute. Serve with 150ml ranch dressing.

s.note: the psych-out at the free throw
s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into bites, dip in water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 15 seconds, salt and bake at 220C for 10 minutes. Melt 200g cheddar into 150ml lager thickened with 1 tbsp cornflour for the dip.

m.how: Simmer 8 bratwurst with 2 sliced onions in 500ml lager for 15 minutes. Grill until browned. Serve in 8 long rolls with the onions, 300g sauerkraut and mustard.

w.note: the game started in the driveway
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over warm chocolate topping, scatter with 50g chopped peanuts and top with a cherry. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Chill 8 cans of lager and pour into plastic cups. Cold lemonade for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
